description: Hand-written keys, relationships and traps for the Olist tables. DuckDB has no declared keys (data loaded from CSV); keys were checked for uniqueness against the data. Join keys match schema_compact.md.

orders.description: One row per order: customer, status and purchase/approval/carrier/delivery/estimated timestamps.
traps: Late = order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date, compared as timestamps.
2016 and Sept-Oct 2018 are incomplete; leave them out of trends.
775 orders have no items and 768 have no review.

order_items.description: One row per item in an order: product, seller, price and freight. The source of revenue.
traps: Revenue = price + freight_value, summed per item (an order with 3 items has 3 rows).
order_item_id is the item's position in the order (1, 2, 3...), not a unique id on its own.

customers.description: One row per order's customer record: zip prefix, city and state.
traps: customer_id is per order; the same person has one customer_unique_id. Count customers with customer_unique_id.

payments.description: Payments per order: type, installments and value. An order can be paid in several parts.
traps: Sum payment_value per order before joining to items, or the totals get multiplied.
payment_value includes freight and is not the revenue definition (use order_items).

reviews.description: Customer reviews: 1-5 score, optional title and comment (mostly Portuguese), dates.
traps: Some orders have more than one review (547 orders), and review_id alone is not unique.
Most comment fields are NULL; comments are in Portuguese.

products.description: Product attributes: category (Portuguese), name/description lengths, photo count, weight and size.
traps: There are no product names, only ids and name lengths.
610 products have a NULL category, and 2 categories have no English translation; use a LEFT JOIN to category_translation.
Columns are spelled 'lenght' as in the source data.

sellers.description: One row per seller: zip prefix, city and state.
traps: Sellers have ids and locations only, with no names.

category_translation.description: Portuguese product category name to English.

geolocation.description: Latitude/longitude samples per zip code prefix, with city and state.
traps: No key: about 1M rows for about 19k zip prefixes. Aggregate per prefix (e.g. AVG lat/lng) before joining, or the rows multiply.
